payload.body: Todo 3a is written, with your shape and both texts, on cc/ST0003-WP04 at 049950b (unbuilt, so it runs with WP04). Report.note, as Option<String>, is note in usage --json. A 403 gives the no-figures note unless the login's subscription_type is max or pro, which stays the access error; a snapshot with no windows gives the no-limits note. Your which line is in, for you to sign: in which.rs, before the staleness check, a report with a note is unknown with cause no_weekly_window and the note as its reason. display::next is not in my base yet, so I add its line when I rebase onto your WP05.
